approval: Intake and direction only; no implementation approval

tickets.title: Confirm first user problem, outcome metric and baseline
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: Human confirmed reliable client inquiries as the first outcome on 2026-11-09. Exact audience, approved destination/status, success metric, baseline window and guardrails remain unresolved; old PRD targets are hypotheses.
tickets.criterion: The human records one confirmed problem/user and a success-metric sentence with inclusions, exclusions, window, baseline period and guardrails, allowing P0 to exit.
tickets.decision: First outcome accepted: trustworthy inquiries. Confirm the exact metric/audience, inclusions/exclusions, destination/status and baseline window before P0 exit; no implementation spec approved.

tickets.title: Decide new Sanity account, project ownership and content retention
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: Human confirmed a new Sanity account and preservation of existing content/images. Existing-project access/ownership versus new-project migration and exact retained document/private-data scope remain unresolved; no reset/deletion authorized.
tickets.criterion: The content owner approves a named account/project/dataset transition and preservation scope with access prerequisites and a reversible migration or access-transfer decision.
tickets.decision: Preserve existing content/images; determine access and exact retention scope before selecting access-transfer versus migration. No deletion/reset, account creation, paid-tier or credential change is implied.

tickets.title: Connect approved Sanity project and permission-scoped environments
tickets.label: enhancement
tickets.problem: Earlier local browser inspection failed on missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_DATASET. Current environment example documents dormant WordPress rather than the active Sanity configuration.
tickets.criterion: In the approved nonproduction environment, public pages read the approved dataset and authorized Studio/comment/review operations use their approved permissions without exposing write credentials to the browser.
tickets.decision: Human provides credentials through an approved secret mechanism and authorizes environment/CORS changes; no secrets in issues.

tickets.title: Restore referenced assets and prove retained content survives the transition
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: No public directory was discovered although active components and metadata reference local fallback assets. A new project may also need asset/document references preserved.
tickets.criterion: Every active local asset reference and every document/asset reference in the approved retained-content scope resolves in the nonproduction target, with a recorded restoration path for migration failure.
tickets.decision: Human confirms asset ownership/source and retained-content inventory; do not fetch or migrate live data without permission.

tickets.title: Replace false contact-delivery success with an approved real inquiry flow
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: The endpoint logs personal fields, delays and returns success without persisting or emailing the inquiry; the UI tells visitors their message was sent.
tickets.criterion: A synthetic inquiry reaches the approved test destination with evidence for the exact accepted/persisted/provider-accepted/delivered state claimed by the UI, and a failure never produces a false success.
tickets.decision: P1 must select receipt/delivery contract, owner destination, provider/storage approach, failure recovery and duplicate-submission policy. Real email/DNS/spend remain human gates.

tickets.title: Honor contact budget and field-validation feedback end to end
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: The form requires and submits budget, but the server drops it. Server validation is basic truthiness/email checking, and the UI hides structured validation errors.
tickets.criterion: Every approved contact field, including budget, is validated server-side and reaches its approved destination unchanged or explicitly normalized, while rejected inputs display the corresponding accessible field error without losing correct input.
tickets.decision: Dev is integration owner; UI may change ContactForm only in a sequential assigned task after the shared contract is approved.

tickets.title: Define and enforce submission privacy, moderation and abuse boundaries
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Contact logs personal data; review emails are stored and labeled private without known dataset access rules; comments expose write errors and filter approval but not spam; parent/post membership validation and abuse controls need an explicit threat/retention contract. Developer halted further discovery on apparently personal hardcoded contact fallback values; their public ownership/approval is unconfirmed and values are not reproduced.
tickets.criterion: An independent reviewer demonstrates that the approved personal-data access/retention and abuse rules hold for synthetic contact/comment/review inputs, including no personal data in logs, no public private-email access, and no displayed spam or cross-post replies.
tickets.decision: Lead obtains human privacy/retention requirements and independent review; do not invent legal compliance claims or add a rate-limit vendor.

tickets.title: Connect approved review submissions to published testimonials
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Submissions create kindWords documents while the homepage reads embedded homeTestimonials.testimonials. Approval alone cannot publish a submission in the current carousel.
tickets.criterion: Under the approved single testimonial-source contract, a synthetic pending review is absent publicly, appears after authorized approval and refresh, and disappears after approval is revoked without exposing its private fields.
tickets.decision: Choose one source of truth and treatment of existing embedded testimonials before migration; preserve existing content unless explicitly approved otherwise.

tickets.title: Keep review submission reachable when no testimonials exist
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: An empty testimonials array hides the entire section, including the Leave a Review entry point.
tickets.criterion: When there are no published testimonials, a visitor can still discover and open the approved review form and sees the approved empty/submission/error states.
tickets.decision: Human approves empty-state copy and placement; UI owns the carousel file.

tickets.title: Apply gallery media selection without requiring attribute filters
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: The displayed list, count and lightbox use all items when no attribute filter is active, ignoring the Photos/Videos media selection.
tickets.criterion: Selecting Photos or Videos with zero attribute filters makes the cards, count and lightbox contain only that media type, with the same result when attribute filters are added or removed.
tickets.decision: Preserve approved exact-match attribute semantics; no redesign or extra search scope.

tickets.title: Show correct gallery empty results and deterministic clear behavior
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Empty-state logic checks the full items collection rather than displayed matches. Clear resets attributes but leaves media unchanged without a confirmed reset contract.
tickets.criterion: A filter combination with no matches displays the approved no-results/reset state, and reset returns exactly the approved media-and-attribute baseline with synchronized count and lightbox.
tickets.decision: P1 defines whether Clear resets media as well as attributes and how total-empty differs from filtered-empty.

tickets.title: Reconcile mobile gallery filters with media and editable CMS fields
tickets.label: enhancement
tickets.problem: Mobile lacks the desktop media switch and exposes vibe/location controls not exposed by the current gallery schema; defaults also differ from older wireframes.
tickets.criterion: Every exposed mobile filter has an approved editable/queryable content field and produces the documented result, including an approved way to select media or an explicit removal of that promise.
tickets.decision: Decide supported attributes and mobile scope; do not silently resurrect old schema fields or promise an unapproved three-column layout.

tickets.title: Make the gallery lightbox operable and understandable by keyboard and assistive technology
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Custom overlay lacks explicit dialog/focus management; some navigation controls lack accessible names and iframes lack titles. Source review is not a conformance audit.
tickets.criterion: A fresh independent keyboard/assistive-technology review confirms the approved dialog semantics, focus containment/restoration, named controls, media labels and close/navigation behavior.
tickets.decision: P1 selects accessibility target and manual test matrix; reuse existing dialog convention where appropriate without changing unrelated UI.

tickets.title: Prevent inactive lightbox videos from playing and handle missing embeds
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Every video iframe is mounted with autoplay parameters rather than only the selected slide; offscreen playback is inferred, not runtime reproduced. Missing embed URLs fall into the image renderer.
tickets.criterion: With two synthetic videos and one malformed video item, only the selected valid video may play, leaving/closing stops playback, and invalid media produces the approved nonplaying fallback.
tickets.decision: Confirm permitted hosts, autoplay policy and fallback semantics; do not contact real third-party media during intake.

tickets.title: Make posts beyond the first blog batch reachable
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Only the initial configured batch loads. Older/Newer controls have no working navigation; there is no infinite loading.
tickets.criterion: For a synthetic collection larger than one approved page, a visitor can reach every eligible post in the documented order without duplicate/omitted boundary items and recover from a failed next-page request.
tickets.decision: P1 chooses pagination versus infinite loading and URL/back-button behavior; dev owns shared route integration, UI review does not write the same file concurrently.

tickets.title: Resolve the blog search field that currently performs no search
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: The sidebar presents an unconnected search field. Search desirability, corpus, matching rules and budget are not established.
tickets.criterion: The sidebar either performs the approved search with normal/empty/loading/error states or no longer presents an input that promises unavailable search.
tickets.decision: Removal or implementation needs human-approved scope; no external search service by default.

tickets.title: Resolve nonfunctional Like, Reblog and misleading Share controls
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: Like/Reblog have no handlers, while Share is another permalink. Their existence does not prove a requirement to build social state.
tickets.criterion: Every remaining feed action produces its explicitly approved observable behavior, and no unavailable action remains presented as working.
tickets.decision: Human selects remove versus implement and confirms labels; persistence/identity for engagement is not authorized.

tickets.title: Align blog post schema, feed query and permalink rendering
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Feed supports photo/quote/link types absent from the active schema; detail query/renderer omits specialized content and custom Portable Text image rendering is not defined.
tickets.criterion: Each approved authorable post type, including body media, renders its primary content consistently in the feed and permalink from the same validated contract, with approved handling of legacy records.
tickets.decision: Human/content owner selects supported types and legacy migration scope; dev integrates query/schema/detail while UI owns feed changes only by sequenced assignment.

tickets.title: Enforce the approved blog archive visibility contract
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: The schema describes archive as hiding public lists, but list queries do not exclude archived posts; permalink visibility is unspecified.
tickets.criterion: Archived synthetic posts obey the approved list/permalink visibility rule across feed queries and cached responses, and unarchiving restores only the approved visibility.
tickets.decision: Confirm list-only versus permalink hiding; do not delete archived content.

tickets.title: Resolve About, Privacy and Terms links without matching pages
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Active links point to /about, /privacy and /terms with no matching page implementation discovered. Legal copy must not be invented. Footer hides below md, so any retained required legal/contact information also needs an approved mobile access path.
tickets.criterion: Every About/legal link exposed to visitors resolves to its approved accessible destination with human-approved content, or is intentionally removed through the approved navigation decision.
tickets.decision: Human supplies/approves legal and About content and chooses build versus removal; no AI legal compliance claims.

tickets.title: Resolve blog tag, Archive, Ask and Submit destinations
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Tag routes are missing; Archive/Ask/Submit have no dedicated routes and instead fall through to ordinary post slug lookups.
tickets.criterion: Each exposed blog navigation destination performs its approved function with defined empty/error behavior and cannot accidentally resolve as an unrelated ordinary post.
tickets.decision: Decide supported destinations; a request for tickets is not approval to build an anonymous ask or content-submission service.

tickets.title: Fix navigation visibility across breakpoints and nested-route active state
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Desktop appears at md while mobile disappears at sm, suggesting a 640–767px gap. Exact-path active checks do not highlight Blog on a post permalink. Gap is source-inferred, not visually reproduced.
tickets.criterion: Across the approved viewport matrix including both breakpoint boundaries, at least one usable primary navigation is visible and nested blog routes expose the approved Blog active state.
tickets.decision: Approve viewport/reflow matrix and active-state semantics; preserve current information architecture pending CW-020/021.

tickets.title: Decide and reconcile Work routes with missing CMS content types
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: Work routes query work/workPage types absent from active Studio registration; missing detail renders null, and primary navigation does not expose Work.
tickets.criterion: The approved keep/consolidate/retire decision leaves no active Work query or public route without an editable source and defined empty/not-found behavior, preserving retained project content.
tickets.decision: Portfolio gallery versus separate projects needs a product/content decision before new schemas or route retirement.

tickets.title: Align homepage View Project links with approved portfolio destinations
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Every View Project featured card links to the generic gallery instead of an individual project; intended destination depends on the Work/Gallery decision.
tickets.criterion: Each featured card label and destination match the approved item-level or collection-level navigation contract, with no misleading View Project link.
tickets.decision: No blind switch to /work/[slug] when featured items are galleryAsset documents rather than work documents.

tickets.title: Reconcile active Sanity schemas and editable page/query contracts
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Queries expect several fields not exposed by current schemas; homePage embeds section settings while active reads use separate section documents. Contact query repeats pageBackground and singleton selection conventions differ.
tickets.criterion: For each approved active page setting, one documented authoring location controls the rendered value under a consistent selection contract, with no uneditable promised field or ambiguous duplicate source.
tickets.decision: Inventory before removal; existing content may use legacy fields. Shared queries/schema files have one dev integration owner.

tickets.title: Restore truthful typecheck and lint gates compatible with installed Next
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Build ignores TypeScript errors; npm lint calls next lint, absent from installed Next 16 CLI; ESLint config/SWC packages remain on Next 13 and React 19 types differ from React 18 runtime.
tickets.criterion: Approved deterministic type/lint/build checks use a compatible toolchain and fail on genuine violations without ignored build errors or weakened rules, with real outputs attached.
tickets.decision: Config, tests and lockfiles are protected; authorize an explicit scoped tooling task and repository trust before any edits or installs.

tickets.title: Define independent acceptance verification and PR evidence gates
tickets.label: documentation
tickets.problem: No test script or test files were discovered and no independent verifier is assigned. Builder opinion or pane state cannot establish readiness.
tickets.criterion: The human-approved plan maps every accepted criterion to a proving command/scenario and a named fresh read-only verifier or human, with done-unverified/verified transitions and protected-file checks defined.
tickets.decision: No test framework/vendor chosen during intake; deterministic output counts only for the behavior it exercises.

tickets.title: Establish measurable analytics, reliability and performance objectives
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: PRD aspirational targets have no supplied baseline or event definitions; lab/field performance, reliability windows, monitoring and privacy consent requirements are unconfirmed.
tickets.criterion: An approved measurement contract defines the outcome event, audience/exclusions/window, diagnostic and guardrail events, baseline period, relevant SLIs/SLOs and collection/verification ownership without inventing results.
tickets.decision: Choose first outcome before tracking; avoid third-party analytics, consent changes or numeric SLOs without approved requirements.

tickets.title: Replace placeholder SEO/domain metadata and missing share-image fallback
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Root metadata hardcodes a production URL and placeholder Google verification code and falls back to /og-image.jpg without discovered public assets; canonical/domain ownership is unconfirmed.
tickets.criterion: In the approved environment, generated metadata and share images resolve to the approved owned domain/assets and contain no placeholder verification value, with page-specific values checked independently.
tickets.decision: Human supplies authoritative domain/verification requirements; no DNS or Search Console mutation.

tickets.title: Update owner and developer docs to the approved actual workflow
tickets.label: documentation
tickets.problem: Docs describe inactive Studio dashboard/Work authoring, older Node requirements, missing write-token setup and features not implemented. Environment template only documents dormant WordPress.
tickets.criterion: A fresh reader can follow the approved setup, content-editing/moderation and verification instructions without invoking inactive features or exposing credentials; implementation status is explicitly separated from product intent.
tickets.decision: Lead owns prose; dev owns any separately authorized environment-template/config changes. Historical PRD intent should not be silently rewritten as approval.

tickets.title: Use one approved source for visible contact details and claims
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: Homepage CTA hardcodes contact details/service claims, while Contact/Footer use CMS values or other fallbacks; displayed/copy-to-clipboard destinations can diverge.
tickets.criterion: All active displayed/copied email, phone, social destinations and service claims match the single human-approved contact content source in normal and missing-content states.
tickets.decision: Human approves public details and service claims; do not copy values from unused cards or invent services.

tickets.title: Assess and retire unused integrations, components and divergent types safely
tickets.label: enhancement
tickets.problem: Dormant WordPress clients, generated local gallery data, alternate UI paths and divergent models increase maintenance ambiguity; presence alone is not proof every dependency is removable. UI intake also found a close button in the previously identified inactive GalleryPreview that only stops propagation; retain/retire its path before treating this as a live-site fix.
tickets.criterion: An approved reference-backed retirement inventory identifies each retained/deleted path and its active consumers, and any executed cutover leaves no broken caller or second competing contract.
tickets.decision: Discovery first; no broad cleanup, lockfile edits or dependency removal during intake. UI reviews removals in its components.

tickets.title: Decide whether dark mode belongs in the first supported experience
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: Dark-mode state/switcher exists but is unmounted; old PRD lists dark mode as future enhancement. There is no current user evidence or approved launch requirement.
tickets.criterion: The human records include/defer/remove for dark mode with an outcome rationale and, only if included, approved preference/persistence, contrast and first-render criteria.
tickets.decision: No automatic activation or redesign based on dormant code.

tickets.title: Decide homepage video scope and media delivery constraints
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: PRD requests autoplay hero/video snippet, but active hero is image-based and standalone video component is unused. MP4 branch still renders img.
tickets.criterion: The human records image-only versus video scope with owned media, fallback, autoplay/reduced-motion, mobile data and performance acceptance requirements before implementation.
tickets.decision: A documented aspiration is not current build authorization; do not enable external embeds or invent performance thresholds.

tickets.title: Decide whether generic page builder and live-preview infrastructure are needed
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: Page builder schemas/renderers/query and SanityLive helpers exist without active route consumers; homepage uses fixed composition. Maintenance value is unproven.
tickets.criterion: The content owner records the concrete authoring job and include/defer/retire decision for generic pages/live preview with an explicit reversal path for retained content.
tickets.decision: Do not wire a new CMS page router, draft-preview token or live service without approved spec and demand.

tickets.title: Confirm current brand, content authority and design acceptance rubric
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: Original docs specify Fitzgerald typography while active UI uses Pattaya/Inter. Approved copy, responsive behavior, accessibility target and design approver are not established. Hero still references the old Fitzgerald class while local font loading is commented out.
tickets.criterion: A human-approved current design/content rubric identifies authoritative fonts/tokens/copy, allowed changes, required states, viewport and accessibility checks so UI can implement without guessing.
tickets.decision: Preserve current photography-first earth-tone direction until approved; no speculative redesign.

tickets.title: Confirm environments, repository trust, CI and progressive-release ownership
tickets.label: question
tickets.problem: Git status was refused for dubious ownership; hosting/preview environments, branch protection, CI requirements and rollback owner are unknown. Vercel is documented intent, not established live configuration.
tickets.criterion: The human approves repository trust and delivery ownership with named nonproduction/production environments, branch/PR rules, independent checks, rollout/rollback criteria and explicit release authority before build or deployment work.
tickets.decision: Do not add global safe.directory, alter CI/secrets, provision infrastructure, deploy or stop herdr on behalf of this ticket without explicit authorization.

tickets.title: Define predictable CMS outage, missing-content and refresh behavior
tickets.label: enhancement
tickets.problem: Page read failure handling and fallback contracts differ; comment reads propagate errors, some pages use hardcoded fallbacks, and review approval/cache refresh behavior lacks a measured freshness contract.
tickets.criterion: For each approved critical CMS read/write flow, a synthetic outage/missing-document/recovery scenario produces the specified truthful state and meets the approved freshness/reliability indicator without silently showing invented content.
tickets.decision: Define critical flows, fresh/stale limits and recovery first; no blanket retries, fake fallbacks or live-content service additions.

tickets.title: Make gallery cards reachable and activatable by keyboard
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: UI source intake found a click-only div opening the lightbox, without native keyboard focus/activation. No runtime accessibility test has run.
tickets.criterion: Each gallery card can be reached and activated through approved native keyboard behavior with an accessible name and visible focus, opening the corresponding item and returning focus on close.
tickets.decision: Approve accessible naming/focus rubric; UI owns cards while lightbox/shared integration is sequenced.

tickets.title: Expose mobile gallery filter dialog and selection state accessibly
tickets.label: bug
tickets.problem: UI intake found an unnamed close button, missing modal focus management and visually selected buttons without exposed selected state. Behavior was not runtime tested.
tickets.criterion: Keyboard and assistive-technology users can open, understand, select within and close the approved filter sheet with contained/restored focus, named controls and programmatically exposed selections.
tickets.decision: Confirm modal semantics and immediate versus Show Results application before implementation.
